vim-zellij-navigator wasm plugin (hiasr 0.3.0, home/.chezmoiexternal.toml): if the focused pane runs nvim it forwards the keypress to nvim (smart-splits) using move_mod "alt" + use_arrow_keys "true", otherwise it performs the zellij move. macOS: Alt = Option (Ghostty sets macos-option-as-alt = true and unbinds option+left/right). Bound inside the locked block, so it works in locked mode — that placement is a local extension: the plugin README only documents shared_except "locked".
